column1: # Each row is an expression, the context it is evaluated against, and what it must produce:
# a value, or an error whose diagnostic contains the given text. A second implementation of
# HEL can run these; this one runs them on both its compiled and its interpreted path, so
# the two cannot agree with each other while disagreeing with the specification.
# NOT COVERED HERE, because this format carries only a data context: eof() and stream.* need
# a stream position, datetime() needs a reference instant, inRegister() needs a register
# provider, partExtension() needs an asset, and sizeof() of a sibling field needs the byte
# spans of a real parse. Those are exercised by the engine suites; the gap is stated here
# rather than left to be inferred from absence.
negative integer division truncates toward zero
division by zero is an error
modulo by zero is an error
conjunction is false when the left is false
disjunction is true when the left is true
a guard needs the ternary, which does short-circuit
substr is zero-based with a length
len of a string counts characters
matches succeeds on a full match
substring slices by position and length
substring past the end is an error, not a clamp
substring with a negative start is an error
concat joins its operands in order
all over an empty array is true
any over an empty array is false
arithmetic on a string is an error
unknown name without a declared schema is absent
